interaction_rules: Raise slider: min = current minimum raise, max = remaining stack (all-in); real-time amount display; supports direct numeric input
Action buttons: only show currently legal actions; sufficiently large tap targets
Fold and all-in require secondary confirmation dialog; other actions execute on single click
BOT thinking: 0.8-1.5s random delay with thinking animation on player seat
Deal animation: 0.3s per card for hole cards and community cards
Chip movement animation: 0.5s for bets and pot collection
Data loading: skeleton screen on first load for history and stats, fade-in when ready
localStorage capacity exceeded: auto-clean oldest 100 hands with toast notification
Leave game during hand: confirmation dialog warning progress will be lost
Empty state: illustration + guidance text + CTA button for no history records
Stats empty state: require minimum 10 hands before showing meaningful statistics
Street timeline: click any street to jump directly, or play linearly
GTO deviation color coding: green = matches GTO, yellow = minor deviation, red = major deviation; consistent everywhere
Hand navigation: previous/next buttons in review without returning to list
Chinese UI with English poker terminology preserved (fold/call/raise/flop/turn/river)
All GTO-related displays include '简化GTO参考' watermark/badge
TopNav highlights current page; pulsing indicator on table tab when game is in progress
